description: Overview of one Taiwan stock or ETF (TWSE or TPEx) by code. security: names, market, kind, industry, listing and founding dates, chairman, president, website, auditor, main business (MOPS), shares outstanding and paid-in capital. quote: the latest trading day's close, change, volume and turnover with the P/E, P/B and dividend yield published by TWSE or TPEx (raw prices, not adjusted for dividends; Taiwan daily prices are government open data), plus change_pct and market_cap (close times shares issued) calculated by Livermore. latest_revenue: the latest month of revenue (see tw_get_monthly_revenue). latest_quarter: revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income attributable to the parent, EPS, margins, growth, ROE and debt ratio for the latest quarter (full statements in tw_get_financials). dividends: cash and stock dividends per share for the last 5 fiscal years (each year added up by Livermore) and the latest or upcoming ex-dividend date. intro: a company profile written by AI from the company's latest annual report (summary, products with revenue shares, markets, customers, suppliers, competitors, industry position, last year's results, outlook, milestones; Traditional Chinese). It may contain errors; the annual report's figures prevail (annual_report_url). industry_chains: the TPEx industry value chain segments the company belongs to, with up to 5 peers per segment by market cap (tw_get_industry_chain lists whole chains). production_sites: factories and other production sites researched by AI from public sources (status operating, under_construction or planned, location, coordinates and their precision, sources per site); coordinates with precision address, region or city come from OpenStreetMap and need the credit in coordinates_credit. urls: the overview, revenue, financials and chips pages. A part is null when there is no data: ETFs and other securities usually have only security, quote and dividends. For price history and daily institutional, margin, securities lending and foreign holding data use tw_get_daily_trading. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

code.description: Taiwan stock code, e.g. 2330 (TSMC), 0050 (an ETF) or 00981A. Lowercase, 2330.TW and 2330.TWO also work. Use tw_search to find a code by company name.

name: tw_get_stock

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

ex_date.description: The latest ex-dividend or ex-rights date (may be announced and still ahead).

cash_per_share.description: Cash dividends per share (TWD), all distributions of the year.

distributions.description: Number of distributions in the year (4 for quarterly payers).

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year the dividends are paid from.

last_period_label.description: The latest distribution's period as written by MOPS in Traditional Chinese (full year, half or quarter).

stock_per_share.description: Stock dividends per share (TWD of par value; 1 TWD = 100 new shares per 1,000 at par 10).

chain_code.description: Industry chain code for tw_get_industry_chain, e.g. D000.

listed.description: false for emerging-market (ESB) and GISA companies, which have no stock page.

stream.description: Upstream, midstream, downstream or another group, in Traditional Chinese.

annual_report_url.description: The annual reports to shareholders of the company on MOPS's document site.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year of the annual report the profile was written from.

basis.description: What the share is based on, e.g. the year's revenue.

debt_ratio_pct.description: Total liabilities divided by total assets (%).

derived.description: The quarter was derived by subtraction from cumulative figures.

eps_derived.description: Q4 EPS calculated by Livermore as full-year EPS minus the first three quarters.

margins.description: Gross, operating and net income as a percent of revenue; null when revenue is not positive.

net_income_parent.description: Net income attributable to owners of the parent.

roe_pct.description: Return on equity (%): net income attributable to the parent divided by average parent equity (start and end of the period); quarterly ROE is for one quarter, not annualized.

yoy_pct.description: Growth (%) against the same period a year earlier: revenue and net income attributable to owners of the parent; null when the base is not positive or not comparable.

company_note.description: The company's explanation of the change, in Traditional Chinese; null when none.

mom_pct.description: Change from the previous month (%), as reported by the company.

revenue_last_year.description: Revenue in the same month a year earlier.

yoy_pct.description: Change from the same month a year earlier (%), as reported.

ytd.description: Revenue from January through this month.

coordinates_credit.description: Required credit when coordinates from OpenStreetMap (precision address, region or city) are used.

coord_precision.description: source: from the cited source; address, region, city: looked up in OpenStreetMap at that level.

kind.description: Fab, assembly plant and so on, in Traditional Chinese.

region.description: Science park or industrial zone; abroad often a state or province.

status_note.description: Expected completion or production timing, as in the source.

change.description: Change from the previous close (TWD), as published; null when not comparable (e.g. ex-dividend).

change_pct.description: change divided by the previous close (%), calculated by Livermore.

close.description: Closing price on close_date (TWD, not adjusted for dividends).

close_date.description: The latest day the stock traded.

date.description: The latest trading day with a quote row (the stock may not have traded that day).

market_cap.description: close times shares_for_market_cap (TWD), calculated by Livermore.

pe_ratio.description: P/E published by TWSE or TPEx for `date`; null for losses or no data.

shares_for_market_cap.description: Shares issued from the latest foreign-holding report (depositary units for TDRs), else shares_outstanding.

industry_code.description: TWSE/TPEx industry code, e.g. 24 for semiconductors (the industry parameter of tw_screen_stocks).

is_active.description: false once the code is no longer traded (delisted).

kind.description: stock = a company (including TDRs); etf; other = preferred shares, ETNs, REITs and similar.

listed_on.description: Listing date on TWSE or TPEx.

main_business.description: Main business lines from MOPS, in Traditional Chinese.

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

president.description: General manager or president, as written by the company.

shares_outstanding.description: Common shares issued (for a TDR, the shares of the foreign company).

chips.description: Daily institutional, margin, securities lending and foreign holding tables.

title: Taiwan stock overview
